news.summary: Capital One has released VulnHunter, an open-source AI security tool. This tool finds software flaws, maps out potential attack paths, and proposes fixes before a single line of code is deployed.
news.enterprise_use: Review and evaluate VulnHunter for potential use in your organization, especially if you have a large codebase or struggle with manual vulnerability detection. Consider testing or integrating this tool with your existing code review processes.

news.summary: Microsoft Research has released Aurora 1.5, an update to the open foundation model, which includes additional variables, hourly temporal resolution, and probabilistic ensemble forecasting. This extends the model's usefulness in real-world weather, climate, and energy applications.
